ra: Pir Benjamin (Binyamin) is the foremost of the Haftan in Yarsan tradition (Hamzeh'ee).
Dawud is counted among the Seven (Haftan) in the Sultan Sahak cycle (Hamzeh'ee).
Pir Musi is one of the Haftan, with a recording/scribe function (Hamzeh'ee).
Mostafa Dawan is counted among the Haftan (Hamzeh'ee).
Ramzbar, the female holy figure, is associated with the Haftan cycle of Sultan Sahak (Hamzeh'ee, Mir-Hosseini).
The Haftawane (Seven Other) form the secondary order ranked beneath the Haftan in Yarsan angelology (Hamzeh'ee).
Sultan Sahak, the central manifestation, gathers and presides over the Haftan of his cosmic cycle (Hamzeh'ee).
Sultan Sahak is the manifestation of the Divine Essence succeeding Shah Khoshin in the Yarsan chain of mazhariyya (Hamzeh'ee).

In the Yarsan chain of manifestations the theophany passes Khawandagar -> Ali -> Shah Khoshin; Shah Khoshin re-manifests the Essence borne by Ali (Hamzeh'ee, Mir-Hosseini). Object ENT_ISL_ALI verified existing.

Yarsan doctrine reinterprets the historical Imam Ali (existing ENT_ISL_ALI) as a manifestation of the Divine Essence succeeding the primordial Khawandagar in the chain of mazhariyya (Hamzeh'ee). Same entity, reinterpreted by Yarsan theology.
Sultan Sahak is held to be a human manifestation (mazhar) embodying the hidden Divine Essence (Dhat) (Mir-Hosseini).
Khawandagar is the first manifestation embodying the Divine Essence in Yarsan cosmology (Hamzeh'ee).
Shah Khoshin embodies the Divine Essence as one theophany in the manifestation chain (Hamzeh'ee).
The doctrine of mazhariyya describes how successive manifestations issue from the hidden Divine Essence (Mir-Hosseini).
The jam assembly is instituted in the cycle of Sultan Sahak and centers Yarsan communal worship (Mir-Hosseini). Direction corrected to ritual->figure per DB convention.
The archetypal first jam is held among the Haftan at creation in the Kalam, the model for the earthly assembly (Hamzeh'ee).
The Kalam-e Saranjam records and transmits the doctrine of successive manifestations (Hamzeh'ee).

The acts and teaching of Sultan Sahak are preserved and revealed through the Kalam-e Saranjam corpus (Hamzeh'ee). Direction corrected to revealer->revealed (the prior revealed_by edge was backwards and that verb is unused in the DB).
Yarsan heptadic angelology and ghulat manifestation theology are functionally aligned with the Alevi-Bektashi heterodox current (van Bruinessen). Object ENT_SUF_BEKTASHI verified existing.
Sultan Sahak as a venerated founder-manifestation parallels Hajji Bektash Wali in the comparative typology of Kurdish/Anatolian heterodoxy (van Bruinessen). Object ENT_SUF_BEKTASH verified existing.
Yarsan tradition reveres al-Hallaj as a figure of the manifest Haqq; his 'ana al-Haqq' resonates with Yarsan manifestation doctrine (Hamzeh'ee). Object ENT_SUF_HALLAJ verified existing.
